what_it_is.prose: BDL is India's DPSU guided-missile prime, headquartered in Hyderabad with manufacturing units at Kanchanbagh, Bhanur (Medak), and Vishakhapatnam. Product portfolio spans the Akash SAM, Astra BVRAAM, MRSAM (co-production with IAI), Konkurs-M ATGM, Milan-2T ATGM, Invar, and the indigenously developed sprint drone-fired missile. BDL is the production agency for the Astra Mk-1 BVRAAM (2022 contract $382.96M/₹2,971 Cr; IAF approved 200 additional missiles Aug 2024) with Astra Mk-2 production contract (~₹3,000 Cr) cleared Dec 2024. BDL signed a Feb 2025 agreement with the Raytheon-Lockheed Javelin JV for ATGM co-production in India, and a Feb 2025 Thales agreement for initial supply of STARStreak MANPADS (first India-made Starstreak deliveries same year). BDL has graduated from missile manufacturer to weapon-system integrator.

rows.india_status: Surface-to-air missile produced by BDL; BEL supplies radars. Indian military combined Akash orders ~₹28,800 Cr

Indigenous beyond-visual-range air-to-air missile (range 80-110 km) integrated on Su-30MKI, Tejas, Mirage 2000, MiG-29. Jun 2022 contract with MoD ~$382.96M (₹2,971 Cr). IAF approved 200 additional Astra Mk-1 Aug 2024. Astra Mk-2 production contract ~₹3,000 Cr cleared Dec 2024. Astra Mk-3 with indigenous seeker in development
BDL manufactures Konkurs-M ATGM (licence from Russia), Milan-2T (licence from MBDA/EU), and Invar (3UBK-20) ammunition under licence for Indian Army's mechanised forces
BDL co-produces MRSAM (Barak-8) jointly with IAI for Indian Air Force and Indian Navy; production facility at Bhanur

Feb 11, 2025 — Thales-BDL agreement for initial supply of STARStreak High Velocity Missiles and launchers; first India-made STARStreak deliveries in 2025; first time India-made STARStreak manufactured
Feb 2025 — BDL signed agreement with Javelin Joint Venture (Raytheon & Lockheed Martin) for ATGM co-production in India
BDL developing drone-launched short-range missiles (1-1.5 km range) for Indian Armed Forces; expected order 2026-27. Tied up with start-ups (News: 2022)
